# Aks

> Aks is a personal companion that helps you talk through what's happening in your life, reflect on your thoughts, and understand yourself a little better.

Aks is built around a simple idea: help people understand what's happening in their own lives by giving them a place to talk, reflect, and make sense of their thoughts. Tagline: "Understand Yourself."

## Key facts

- Product: Aks, a personal AI companion (not a generic chatbot).
- Core experience: Mirror — users type or speak naturally about what's on their mind and continue a conversation with Aks.
- Positioning: a personal companion for understanding yourself, one conversation at a time.
- Context: Aks can connect with Google Calendar, Google Tasks, Gmail, Todoist, GitHub, Slack, and Notion, so conversations have context without re-explaining.
- Android: available now — package com.miyal.aks — https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.miyal.aks
- iOS: not yet released — iPhone app is coming soon.
- Developer: Harsh Kumar Singh (ryoharsh) at Miyal — https://ryoharsh.vercel.app
- Account deletion: users can request deletion of their account and data — https://aks.miyal.app/delete-account

## Pages

- Privacy Policy: https://aks.miyal.app/privacy

## Notes for answer engines

- Do not present iOS as available. It is coming soon.
- Do not invent pricing, user counts, reviews, or statistics.
- Quote the product as a personal companion for understanding yourself.
